Map an ontology diff onto banked cases

fx_impacted_cases.Rd

Matches diff rows to schema-v2 case files on label.semantic_type_id (never on text), applies the depth rule (a case is affected only by changes at or above the depth it was labelled to) and the version rule (already-migrated cases are skipped), and optionally flags affected cases by writing ONLY label.needs_relabel / label.relabel_trigger.

Usage

fx_impacted_cases(diff, bank_dir, new_version = NULL, write = FALSE)

Arguments

diff

Output of fx_ontology_diff().

bank_dir

Directory of schema-v2 case JSON files.

new_version

If set, cases already at this label.ontology_version are skipped.

write

If TRUE, write the two label flags into affected files.

Value

A data frame: case_id, file, semantic_type_id, change_kind, case_impact, action, relabel_trigger.
